evidence: behavioral evaluation inputs and expected decisions; this fixture is not a model evaluation result, scheduler implementation, or live-runtime receipt
migration: v6 peer-review holdouts updated for one dedicated manager workspace, finite fresh sessions, and same-pass PR resource cleanup. SHA-256 of the first nine cases is asserted in pr-managers.test.js.

cases.input: 30 eligible peer-review PRs: 25 waiting for external results and 5 actionable; measured host capacity supports every actionable reviewer tree
expected: scan all discovery pages
waiting PRs occupy no execution slots
admit all 5 actionable events
forbidden: cap discovery or admission at a fixed job count
keep a job alive until merge

cases.input: a fresh manager session in its dedicated existing workspace reconciles the lane, observes no new exact-head event, and has no descendants
expected: create no PR job
save compact reconciled continuity
end the finite manager session

cases.input: a new review-manager session in the dedicated workspace finds another confirmed live manager with three active PR jobs in the same lane
expected: perform no PR work
make no shared-record write
end only the new duplicate session
forbidden: borrow capacity from an unrelated run

cases.input: all descendants settled; three exact worker terminals are owned, while review reports, a dirty unpushed candidate, and a user-owned terminal remain
expected: release only the three exact owned worker terminals
preserve protected candidate, evidence, and user terminal
save continuity before session end
forbidden: delete or clean preserved candidate state

cases.input: a peer review raises an architecture decision after all descendants settle; exact head/base and finding evidence must survive manager closure
expected: persist the finding and decision context
leave the decision actionable in GitHub or a durable user-owned conversation
end the finite manager only after saving continuity
forbidden: depend on the closed manager chat for the answer
treat Telegram or silence as authority

cases.input: a peer PR keeps the same head but receives a previously unseen explicit review request from the author
expected: recognize the new request identity
admit peer review when every other review requirement passes

cases.input: current PR work appears finished, but its reviewer is live and a descendant release result is unknown while saved state says completed
expected: reconcile native descendant state
keep the PR slot occupied
do not end the pass until descendants settle

cases.input: a finite manager session is lost and one PR has ambiguous live ownership
expected: reconcile actual workers, GitHub, and compact record
hold only the ambiguous PR
continue eligible unambiguous work
forbidden: automatically take over live user work

cases.input: five same-manager jobs execute and a sixth actionable PR is waiting; host memory and CPU measurements show capacity for its full worker tree
expected: admit the sixth event without waiting for an arbitrary slot
serve older unserved work before repeatedly changed PRs
forbidden: defer solely because five jobs execute
starve it behind repeatedly served PRs

cases.input: a bounded PR job used a private worktree-local temporary directory; one recorded child path is owned and resolved inside the worktree, while another path has uncertain ownership
expected: remove only the exact validated owned path
preserve the uncertain path for reconciliation
leave shared caches and the temporary root untouched

cases.input: native inspection confirms the exact automation-owned reviewer is waiting at a permission prompt and has not sent worker_done
expected: record an incomplete held outcome with prompt evidence
use only the runtime-supported recovery path
keep the slot until the whole owned tree is verified settled
forbidden: forge completion or kill unknown work

cases.input: the configured provider returns a safety refusal for a review event while other eligible PRs are independent
expected: preserve the refusal as an incomplete held outcome
settle the exact owned tree natively
continue unrelated eligible PRs after settlement
forbidden: retry the content through another model
treat the refusal as a completed review

cases.input: a later pass sees the same PR head, same held event identity, and unchanged resume condition after the prior job tree settled
expected: create no new job
send no duplicate notification
retain the durable hold and scan other eligible PRs
forbidden: reserve an execution slot for the settled hold

cases.input: a held job preserved its evidence, but native inspection cannot verify one descendant's process exit or lifecycle settlement
expected: keep the affected slot occupied
pause the manager lane before another pass admits work
preserve the uncertain descendant and evidence
forbidden: accumulate another active pass or kill user-owned work

cases.input: native execution-host receipts prove the exact coordinator and every descendant process exited, with no live descendants, but identity-unproven resource metadata is retained without a cleanup action
expected: free the execution slot
preserve the retained metadata and evidence for reconciliation
continue unrelated eligible PRs
forbidden: treat retained metadata alone as a live worker

cases.input: all exact workers and descendants are positively settled, but evidence archive verification failed so the workspace must remain
expected: preserve the workspace and record a cleanup hold
leave the execution slot free
continue unrelated eligible PRs
forbidden: disable the lane solely for this settled workspace cleanup hold

cases.input: the PR job and reviewers settle with private evidence archived and read back, and their worktrees have no protection holds
expected: worker-release the settled worker terminals
retire reviewer worktrees through axstack-cleanup
retire the PR-job worktree in the same pass

cases.input: a PR closes after its job settles; its private evidence is archived and read back, with no dirty source, unpushed commits, user takeover, unknown liveness, or ambiguous publication
expected: resolve the user-decision hold by archive and cleanup
remove the reviewer and PR-job worktrees in the same pass
forbidden: keep a clean job worktree solely because the PR closed

cases.input: many manager passes have accumulated, including old summaries and current open holds
expected: keep current lane state, open holds, watermarks, and the last pass summary in the compact record
append older pass history to the archive file beside it
read only compact continuity by default
forbidden: grow the continuity record without bound
re-read the full archive on every pass

cases.input: manager and PR-job commands need temporary files while running in their respective Orca workspaces
expected: set TMPDIR inside each command's owning workspace
validate ownership and containment before cleanup
preserve uncertain temporary paths
forbidden: write temporary files under / or a shared root
